entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud service.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across 25+ LLM providers. It offers flexible deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud, supported by client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains, archiving sessions as editable Markdown files.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that runs locally on CPU. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations while supporting custom data models and ontologies.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at high scale. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and video with byte-level deduplication.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance to support corrections and withdrawals of information. It provides a synthesis layer for cited answers and exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the Hermes-compatible self-hosted wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, integrating with MCP and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Designed for Hermes Agents, this zero-dependency system requires only Python and a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to manage storage growth and integrates natively with OpenWebUI and MCP.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts durable knowledge from ephemeral conversation streams and reconciles conflicting information by superseding old beliefs. It allows users to export their memory estates as plain Markdown using the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki for structured fact recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness helps agents succeed on complex tasks by generating playbooks and training artifacts from task runs. It supports various endpoints including vLLM and Ollama, providing entry points via CLI, MCP, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides a lossless context engine for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite for message persistence. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to recover specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It operates locally to track file edits, command exit statuses, and specific session spans across months of past data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted backend supported by Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving high accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disks for multi-agent systems. It utilizes local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to synchronize memory across various coding agents.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It fuses BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal to capture agent decisions and preferences from session transcripts.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent and other platforms by reordering text and multimodal context for prefix-cache sharing. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling to improve inference efficiency.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled item with a reason for its selection. It functions as an embedded in-process backend that tracks contradictions and conflicts without requiring an external server.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with agents via MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This proactive memory CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve persistent knowledge across sessions using local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with built-in permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for automated configuration with major coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This project acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to manage state and provides agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory for agents using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tools. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer manages workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex by converting chats into reviewable files. It requires manual review for context proposals and integration enablement to maintain control over the context layer.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory plugin, this project supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for monitoring all memory operations.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide agents with concise system-prompt hints via session hooks. It offers five native tools for searching, retrieving, and providing feedback on local artifacts.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to manage budget-bound wallets directly.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-session and cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and employs a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking, offering specific tools for manual memory storage and searching.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads and indexing.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers AI-native long-term memory with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and MinHash deduplication. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval modes, and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency through automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation loop identifies 'rot' and contradictions within markdown files to propose evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review. It functions without a database, instead leveraging a local git repository to track and revert changes to the agent's memory.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtimes through the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to bolster security-specific capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features an optional MCP server and supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates verification and dispute resolution layers to facilitate secure natural-language mandates and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this project audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It offers professional, technical, and casual voice profiles across detect-only, rewrite, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across devices and team members. It integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to allow skills to evolve collectively in the background.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation folder to support persistent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 1,176 markdown-based skills covering 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. These professional skills are designed for immediate use and include ready-to-paste exports for various assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands for managing the resulting library.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources for Pydantic AI. It enhances agent safety by including sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host system while providing tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically synchronizes source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures output quality by utilizing a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams through the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills, facilitating structured memory and event logging.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, allowing agents to effectively train their own successors.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. It supports flexible skill installation through a CLI tap or raw URLs to assist Brazilian Hermes Agent users.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports specific integrations like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, and is installable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX image and video generation capabilities, including a specialized video suite with eight distinct skills. The project supports BFL API integration for polling and webhooks alongside specific prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates verified instruction files from code repositories and documentation, mapping instructions to specific source lines or URLs. It automates the entire lifecycle of skill creation, including briefing, testing, and exporting compliant skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first Rust binary that uses a four-verb language to execute workflows with hash-chained records for tamper-evident verification. It prioritizes security and transparency by performing static audits of costs and permissions before execution.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the use of reusable AI skills through a Python client and a CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It uniquely incorporates commerce features by supporting skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures reliability during long-running operations through built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification, this hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installations. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that utilizes hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data in a local SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This adversarial code review skill uses three parallel subagents to identify bugs and edge cases without modifying the source code. It combines deterministic scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings triaged in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, while supporting 97 languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite based on five quality dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition to ensure evidence-based verification for Hermes. It includes a Python-based goal engine for persistent state management and causal debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards to address real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides production-tested skills for session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration across multiple AI coding environments. It installs as drop-in markdown files and includes a bundled installer for managing updates and drift checks.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics without outbound telemetry. It enforces strict read-only data access and supports optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It optimizes output files for sizes under 8 MB and supports terminal interfaces, web apps, and libraries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and propose updates. It gates changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while monitoring official specifications to detect field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and supports workspace Postgres and scheduling.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for e-commerce workflows, converting video content into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports OpenClaw and Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin facilitates earning or paying USDC on the Base network for support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and buying context, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests and incorporates quality gates to produce briefings that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes and other coding agents through pre-indexed project data. It features automated background synchronization and auto-configures as an MCP server to streamline agent integration.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility designed to track token consumption across multiple AI agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard, allowing developers to monitor usage and submit data to public leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It exports sessions into self-contained HTML viewers for detailed analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 40+ other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to provide historical usage breakdowns across different machines and projects.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that loads 36 skills and 6 specialized roles into Hermes Agent to coordinate a 'CTO loop' for application development. It automates the entire lifecycle from building to operating apps, including health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project allows for the customization of the Hermes terminal UI using YAML-based themes. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control that supports external MCP clients and browser automation. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with @handles. It enables Hermes agents to engage in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, eliminating the need for external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that uses HERM v1.1 scoring to identify ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions. It supports MCP and function-tool definitions, generating SARIF and JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms and development environments, including VS Code and Slack.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup integrates RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories, tools, and instructions. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration of the directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack along with 12 supporting services and 29 community plugins. It offers three scalable deployment tiers, ranging from a minimum viable setup to a full production stack, at zero cost using free models.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift against config-aware baselines.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime operations, this tool functions as a deterministic, zero-network environment for executing financial opportunities. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit user approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages and featuring adaptive turn-taking with barge-in functionality. It operates entirely locally without the need for API keys, accounts, or external service dependencies.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for agent data. It includes built-in tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux facilitates one-click switching between different API providers. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local cowork application that enables 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access interfaces. It supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and includes built-in assistants for generating editable office documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on browsers and mobile devices. It utilizes a three-panel layout for chat, sessions, and workspace browsing without relying on external frameworks or bundlers.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app that offers guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. The GUI includes dedicated modules for session management, memory, and tool configuration across multiple AI providers and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard features visual workflows with schedules, human approval gates, and unified configuration for ten platforms including Telegram and Discord. It also provides detailed usage analytics for tracking token breakdown and costs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a swarm mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an inspector panel for managing skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative coding workspace aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It is available as a desktop app, a self-hosted server, or via native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside standard chat and memory management tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local gateways or remote Hermes APIs. It provides site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and multi-agent switching.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and mobile management of server file systems.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a tmux operator view specifically designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and tracking agent health via the ZOO Swarm Monitor. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a kanban pipeline for overseeing the agent stack.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search local agent histories, including prompts, tool calls, and command outputs. It functions as a cockpit for tracking per-session token burn and estimated API-equivalent costs without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP to manage remote cloud computers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI runs as a Telegram Mini App, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for secure validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop environment runs via portable Python and Node.js without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools covering TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes dedicated management tools for tracking tasks, cron jobs, skills, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on process transparency, allowing for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code. It provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs alongside read-only views of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace uses real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for installing skills and MCP servers, with isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat.
